# Tests AnyTogether CI leaves out of the Mac launcher's `swift test` (tools/macos/launcher), one per line:
# <regular expression for Target.TestCase/test> <reason>
# Only for tests that depend on the runner rather than the code (real-time timing, devices).

AnyPS5SharePlayTests.SharePlayOpusTests/testAViewerSayingHelloHearsStereoOpus  Real-time WebRTC audio: the jitter buffer and packet rate it measures go past its limits on a shared runner.
AnyPS5CoreTests.BrowserPadServerTests/testABrowserScansPairsAndDrivesTheGame  Real-time: counts the pad keep-alive repeats within 1.5 s of wall clock, which a busy runner does not always reach.
AnyPS5Tests.FastInputTests/testTheBackdropFadesOnlyToTheGameTheSelectionRestsOn  Real-time: moves every key-repeat interval with Task.sleep against the settle timer; a busy runner oversleeps and the selection rests mid-run (failed on main too, run 40943992702).
